tomb_guide.text: Quiet, please. This is a five-thousand-year-old burial chamber, not a bus shelter. I'll turn out the lights, and you'll see what the sun did every winter.
The lights go down, the lamp goes gold, a single beam crawls up the floor. People gasp. A few cry. I've seen a grown man ask for his mother.
